passage:
Dear Team,

Thanks for being patient while we update the security systems here at the North Tower. As you know, we started using a new fingerprint and eye scanner system last Monday. We did this to keep the building safer and make it easier to get in after hours. Unfortunately, we've run into a few bumps during the launch.

Over the last two days, a lot of people have reported issues with their access cards. Specifically, some older cards are showing "Access Denied" at the main gates between 6:00 PM and 8:00 PM. This has been tough on the research team—a few senior analysts actually got locked out of the lab while running urgent experiments. On top of that, the scanners by the main elevators are running really slow. This caused long lines during the morning rush on Tuesday, making about thirty people roughly twenty minutes late.

To fix these problems, SecureTech Solutions will be in the Grand Ballroom this Thursday to adjust the system. You must attend one of these sessions. Please bring your employee ID card and your smartphone so we can set up the new secure app on your phone.

Morning session: 9:00 AM – 11:00 AM
Afternoon session: 2:00 PM – 4:00 PM

Everyone needs to finish this registration by Friday afternoon. If you miss the deadline, your building access will be turned off. Starting next Monday, anyone who didn't sign up will need to grab a temporary visitor pass and have someone escort them to their desks.

We know these tech glitches are frustrating, especially since everyone is busy preparing the Q3 financial reports. To say thank you for working with us, we are providing a free lunch from The Green Deli in the break room for everyone who attends a Thursday session.

Thanks for understanding as we make the workplace safer and smoother.

Best,
Amara Vance
Director of Operations
North Tower Facility
